card.name: Linking words before spray or spine actions
card.fires_on: Small linking words (and, by, that) right after a noun or verb phrase, where a describing action comes next. Mostly in nasal spray priming steps, and in animal descriptions of spines or hairs.

modes.label: Spray priming steps
modes.description: The word 'by' or 'and' just before 'releasing' or 'actuating' sprays when priming a pump.
